items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: there was a salesman there named Uly Apfell, who for some reason took a liking to me... I went down and got it.

ctx.x: Yes. But there was a salesman there named Uly Apfell, who for some reason took a liking to me, and he says, "Hey, kid, I've got this Morelli bass from Germany, and I think you should have it." So I went down and got it.
